information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTk3NzM1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--452320b66befe4473e64714d2b10c5758fa03f1f/BR%20(2).png) Esta competição contará **apenas com a modalidade 3x3x3 Menos Movimentos** e será realizada em vários [locais](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FacaMaispelasCriancas2026#79950-cidades-cities)! Os locais podem ser adicionados até o dia 18 de setembro às 23:59 UTC, portanto, se ainda não houver um local próximo a você, entre em contato com o [Delegado](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/delegates) local. --- ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTk3NzM0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--7cc91f261678c6cb3253be36e27fef7f8f3b2c35/UK%20(2).png) This competition will hold **only 3x3x3 Fewest Moves event**, and it will be held in multiple [locations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FacaMaispelasCriancas2026#79950-cidades-cities)! Locations may be added until the 18th of September 23:59 UTC so if there isn't a location near you yet contact your local [Delegate](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/delegates).
